script_text: Gemini, the stars are aligning to turn your week into a dramatic cosmic dance and opportunities. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury squares Saturn in your 7th House, creating partnership tension. Tuesday's Sun trine your 1st House lifts confidence, while Wednesday's Venus opposite Pluto in your 5th House sparks passionate romance. Mid-week, the Moon enters your 9th House, signaling a shift toward broader perspectives. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter trines your 3rd House, inspiring quick ideas and short journeys and personal growth. Mars in your 10th House fuels career ambition, and a Sun‑Saturn sextile in your 6th House promotes disciplined work. Your best day is Wednesday, when Venus enters your 5th House, igniting creativity and love. Your worst day is Monday, as Mercury squares Saturn, causing contract confusion. Embrace your Air element curiosity, let Mercury guide your words, but anchor decisions with Saturn's discipline. Follow for daily updates.
